strict_rubric_deduction_rules.name: Missing or Incorrect SI Unit
strict_rubric_deduction_rules.description: Any final numerical or derived scalar/vector value lacking explicit standard SI unit (e.g. N/C, V/m, Tesla, Ohm, Farad) suffers mandatory 0.5 mark deduction.

strict_rubric_deduction_rules.name: Unlabelled or Incomplete Scientific Diagram
strict_rubric_deduction_rules.description: Scientific apparatus, field lines, or circuit diagrams missing coordinate axes, polarity (+/-), directional arrows, or component labels suffer mandatory 1.0 mark deduction.

strict_rubric_deduction_rules.name: Skipped Intermediate Vector Calculus / Calculus Step
strict_rubric_deduction_rules.description: Directly jumping from closed surface integral to algebraic result without defining differential area vector dS or surface boundary conditions.

strict_rubric_deduction_rules.name: Improper Rounding or Precision Truncation
strict_rubric_deduction_rules.description: Premature truncation of decimals during intermediate division steps yielding discrepancy > 1% in final result.

criteria.step: Closed Gaussian surface diagram with dS vector and E vector arrows
Integration steps: flux = closed_integral(E . dS) = q_enclosed / epsilon_0
Final scalar/vector equation with standard SI units (N m^2 C^-1)
Torque equation derivation: tau = p x E
Cross product magnitude tau = p * E * sin(theta)
Special cases: stable equilibrium (0 deg) and maximum torque (90 deg)
Statement of Kirchhoff's Current Law and Voltage Law
Wheatstone bridge four-arm circuit diagram with galvanometer G
Final balance relation: P / Q = R / S

questions.topic: Biot-Savart Law on Circular Current Loop

criteria.step: Statement and differential vector formula: dB = (mu_0 / 4pi) * (I dl x r) / r^3
Circular loop coordinate diagram with axial distance x and radius R
Integration along loop perimeter (integral dl = 2pi R)
Final magnetic field at center B = mu_0 * I / (2 * R) with Tesla unit
